gaps: No numeric benchmark scores (GenEval, DPG-Bench, T2I-CompBench, FID, CLIP score, PickScore, ImageReward, Artifactor) were extracted from any downloaded source for any of the 41 models.
Many model announcement/blog pages (Recraft, OpenAI GPT-Image-1.5, OpenAI GPT-Image-2) returned 404 or redirect errors, preventing access to provider-reported benchmark data.
HuggingFace model cards for BFL and ByteDance models required authentication (403) and could not be read.
The Artifactor Benchmark leaderboard (likely containing comparative scores across models) could not be accessed via HuggingFace Spaces or GitHub Pages - JS-rendered content not captured.

Search for 'GenEval', 'DPG-Bench', 'FID', 'CLIP score', 'ImageReward', 'PickScore', 'aesthetic score' across all downloaded HTML pages did not yield numeric benchmark tables - benchmark data appears to be dynamically loaded/rendered and not present in static HTML.
Google Gemini image generation documentation (ai.google.dev) provides details about model capabilities but no numeric benchmark results in the static HTML captured.
Seedream paper reference (arxiv.org/abs/2504.04362) returned incorrect content - the arXiv abstract page redirects to a different paper, not the Seedream text-to-image paper.
Recraft documentation was checked, but it does not establish a general architecture or wrapper relationship for every listed model.

All 41 models lack published independent benchmark evidence from checked sources. This is a systematic gap due to: (a) the static HTML capture approach missing JavaScript-rendered benchmark tables, (b) many models being very recent releases with limited published evaluations, and (c) access restrictions on HuggingFace model card pages.
